title: The Lead Magnet Ladder: The lead magnet strategy mistake that's costing you qualified leads
caption:
The lead magnet strategy mistake that's costing you qualified leads

Do this in the next 15 minutes:
1️⃣ Solve one narrow problem — Not 'grow your business' — 'write a cold email that gets replies'.
2️⃣ Deliver value in 5 min — A checklist, template, or calculator. Something usable immediately.
3️⃣ Ask for email only — One field. Every extra field halves your conversion.
4️⃣ Follow up automatically — A 3-email welcome flow that delivers more and pitches once.

Report back after you do it.
